managed_note_unnamed: Enter the number of the person this profile is for, not your own.

consent.title: Why we ask for the CNIC number
consent.body: We ask for the candidate's CNIC (or NICOP, POC or passport) number so that each person can have only one profile, and so that anyone removed for bad behaviour cannot come back.
consent.point_hidden: It is never shown on the profile or to any other member.
consent.point_encrypted: It is stored encrypted. Only the last four digits are ever displayed, and only to you.
consent.point_not_shared: We do not share it with anyone outside Khandani Rishta.
consent.point_deleted: It is deleted when the account is deleted.
